title: Implement repository pattern with all CRUD functions
description: Create src/db/repository.ts as the single point of database access for the entire application. All other files import from repository.ts — never from schema.ts or index.ts directly. This isolates all DB logic and makes the Supabase migration a one-file change.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/db/repository.ts` exports functions for all CRUD operations on all tables
No other file in src/ imports from `src/db/index.ts` or `src/db/schema.ts` directly
All repository functions are typed with proper TypeScript return types
Repository functions for prospects include status update helpers
Batch CRUD functions work correctly (create, list, get by id)
Prospect functions include: create, list by batch, get by id, get by slug, update, update status
Media functions include: create, list by batch
Email functions include: create sent email record
Settings functions include: get by key, set by key, get all

steps.details: Export functions: `createBatch(data)`, `getBatch(id)`, `listBatches()`. Use Drizzle's `db.insert().values()`, `db.select().from()`, `db.query.batches.findFirst()` pattern. All IDs should be generated with `crypto.randomUUID()` by the caller or inside the function.

Export: `createProspect(data)`, `createProspects(data[])`, `getProspect(id)`, `getProspectBySlug(slug)`, `listProspects(batchId)`, `updateProspect(id, data)`, `updateProspectStatus(id, status)`. The `updateProspectStatus` function should also update `updated_at` to `Date.now()`.
Export: `createMedia(data)`, `listMediaByBatch(batchId)`, `getMediaBySlotAndIndustry(batchId, slot, industry)`. The last function is used by the image assignment logic to find manual uploads.

steps.description: Add sent email and settings functions
steps.details: Email: `createSentEmail(data)`, `listSentEmailsByProspect(prospectId)`. Settings: `getSetting(key)`, `setSetting(key, value)`, `getAllSettings()`. Settings uses upsert pattern: `db.insert(settings).values({key, value}).onConflictDoUpdate({target: settings.key, set: {value}})`.

steps.description: Add TypeScript types for repository inputs
steps.details: Export TypeScript types: `NewBatch`, `NewProspect`, `UpdateProspect`, `NewMedia`, `NewSentEmail` using Drizzle's `InferInsertModel` and `InferSelectModel` helpers. Example: `export type Prospect = InferSelectModel<typeof prospects>`.

steps.description: Verify no direct db/schema imports outside repository
steps.details: Search the codebase for imports of `src/db/index` or `src/db/schema` outside of `src/db/repository.ts` and `src/db/migrate.ts`. There should be none. All app code should import from `src/db/repository`.

technicalNotes: The repository pattern is critical for the Supabase migration path. When we swap SQLite for Postgres, only schema.ts, index.ts, repository.ts, and drizzle.config.ts change — the rest of the app is untouched.
JSON blob fields should be serialized/deserialized in the repository: accept objects, store as JSON.stringify(), return as JSON.parse().
